scenario: 1:1 match despite different quoted prior sizes
description: Matching aligns findings on clinical equivalence, not on attribute agreement. Both sides describe a dilated common bile duct that has worsened to 8 mm, so they match even though the texts quote different prior sizes (5 vs 6 mm); a prior size is carried by the comparison, not extracted as a measurement, and no attribute difference is a reason to leave either side unmatched.

pred_findings.text: Common bile duct dilated to 8 mm, increased from 5 mm previously.

gt_findings.text: Common bile duct measures 8 mm, up from 6 mm on the prior study.

matches.reasoning: Same dilated common bile duct, whatever prior size each report quotes.
